Booz Allen Hamilton is seeking a Junior Full Stack Software Engineer to support its Wargaming and Modeling & Simulations team. The role develops and maintains frontend and backend web applications, APIs, data integrations, testing, deployment automation, and technical documentation using Python and modern web technologies.

Responsibilities
The engineer will contribute across the application stack, including user interfaces, backend services, data integration, testing, and deployment
Work with users and technical team members to understand requirements and build practical software solutions
Develop and maintain web applications across frontend and backend components
Build backend services, APIs, and application logic using Python
Develop user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks and languages and integrate applications with databases, APIs, and other data sources
Write, test, debug, and maintain reliable software
Other responsibilities include using Git and collaborative software development workflows, researching unfamiliar technical problems and evaluating new tools and approaches, and contributing to application deployment, automation, and technical documentation

Experience with AI/ML, geospatial systems, modeling and simulation, or defense-related applications
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or similar environments
Experience with containers such as Docker
Ability to demonstrate an interest in learning application deployment, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and software security best practices
Ability to work in small teams where engineers may contribute across multiple parts of a system
